audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Poppy level 3, first item and 2+ items and gave Skill to level 6. Every one of those rows contradicts its own why: level 3 'pulls the trade back to even', level 6 is where 'Feast lands' and gives you 'a kill threat her tankiness cannot answer', first item makes 'extended standing trades yours', and two items is 'fights stay even'.
audit.why: Poppy's power is Hammer Shock burst and passive resistances at 2, not at first item; Cho'Gath's is Feast, which is true damage and therefore the one thing her scaling resistances cannot answer.
audit.corrected: Skill / Poppy / Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Skill — matching the packet chart exactly. Proposed as one atomic group across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side+rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase text named Heartsteel as the fight-forcing spike and 'levels 2-3 (full pattern)' as Cho'Gath's window, which is Poppy's window.
audit.why: The spikes are level 2 for her (Hammer Shock plus Steadfast Presence resistances), level 6 for you (Feast), first item for you (HP plus Carnivore wins long trades), and Keeper's Verdict at 140s as her late-game relevance.
audit.corrected: phases[1..6].why rewritten to that order with the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. Wrong: wants.foe[1], spikes[3].text and whys[6] say Poppy's W 'eats your gap-close' and 'denies your chase'. Steadfast Presence stops dashes — Cho'Gath has no dash, and Rupture is a ground-target knockup, not a dash. Against him that half of her W is dead weight; what actually matters is its move speed and its low-health armour and MR. Missing: Keeper's Verdict is a channel, so a Rupture knockup cancels it outright and costs her the full 140s.
audit.why: The existing text has the player playing around an ability that cannot touch him, and never mentions the one interaction where Cho'Gath's slow, telegraphed Q is worth its cooldown. It also matters that her W resistances rise as she drops low, which is precisely when Feast's true damage stops caring.
audit.corrected: W's dash-stop described as irrelevant here in dosFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns; the channel cancel written into report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d and spikes[3].text.
sources: champ-data/_kits/poppy.json (R description says 'channels'; kit flag channel: 'interruptible — any CC cancels it')

notes: The Steadfast Presence correction is worth a second look across the whole roster: the FULL and content layers treat 'stops dashes' as a generic disengage, but against a dashless champion like Cho'Gath that clause is inert, and the same will be true of every dash-stop and grounding effect in every Cho'Gath matchup. A flag-crossing pass over kitFlags.grounding versus owners with no dash would surface all of them at once. NOT ASSERTED: Poppy's R carries both a 'channel' and an 'untargetable' derived flag; Riot's description says only that she 'channels a hammer strike', so I wrote the channel-cancel interaction (Medium confidence, flagged as such) and said nothing at all about untargetability, which the description does not support. Also not asserted: whether Heroic Charge's wall stun is reduced by tenacity, and whether Poppy's Iron Ambassador buckler can be denied. The FULL layer still calls Poppy 'he' in breakdown.feeding, dontsFull[0].d and report[12] — pronoun errors outside the fields I edited.
